product_desc: A 14-inch Dell Inspiron 7000 series laptop, featuring an InfinityEdge display and diamond-cut edges, powered by 8th Generation Intel Core processors for versatile performance.

product_features.Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U or Intel Core i7-8550U (8th Generation)
product_features.Storage: Hybrid configurations including up to 512GB SSD and/or up to 1TB HDD
product_features.Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 (Integrated) with optional NVIDIA GeForce MX150 2GB GDDR5 (Discrete)
product_features.Ports: 2x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0, 1x HDMI, 1x Headphone output, 1x Ethernet (RJ-45), SD card reader
product_features.Special Features: InfinityEdge display, diamond-cut edges, integrated HD 720P webcam with dual digital microphone array, built-in speakers
